Every brand running Axon, plus every Largest and Large consumer brand not yet on it (about 56K named brands). Fit ranks how closely a brand matches those that already adopted. Smaller brands are counted in the map but not named here.

DomainStatusCategorySizeAd pixelsPlatformFit

Independent analysis of public data. Not affiliated with AppLovin. Source: HTTP Archive mobile crawl (15.4M homepages), Meta and TikTok pixels detected by Wappalyzer. Subdomains merged into one brand. Categories tagged from site text, about 85% accurate on a hand check. Axon detected from network requests, including Shopify-app installs that standard detection misses. Homepage-only, so counts are a floor; shares compare like with like. Channel pattern is correlation, used as a targeting signal. Prepared by Krishna Goli.
